'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=钱坤}} is an NPC who helps collect [[Unclaimed Rafter Kite]] for [[Qiuhong]] during the day.
{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Chiwen:''' I heard you found a Rafter Kite with quite a bit of history behind it?

:'''Chiwen:''' Rafter Kites wanted! Unclaimed ones especially. Fair rates, no haggling!

===Variation 2===
;Night, switching with [[Qiuhong]]
:'''Chiwen:''' Commander... Err... Mr. Qiuhong! I have the Rafter Kites from today right here, sir.
:'''Qiuhong:''' I appreciate your hard work, Chiwen. I'll take it from here.

;Morning, switching with Qiuhong
:'''Chiwen:''' You've been up all night, and still look all spruced and nice. Now wondering whose shift it's supposed to be...
:'''Qiuhong:''' It's normal for older folks to sleep less. What's there to be surprised about?
:'''Chiwen:''' The shift's yours. I'm gonna have a look around and come back later.

===Variation 2===
;Morning, switching with Qiuhong
:'''Qiuhong:''' You're here early. Had anything to eat yet? Why don't we head to Yuan's Flavors for some noodles?
:'''Chiwen:''' I've already eaten. No need to trouble yourself over me... Commander. I mean. Mr. Qiuhong.
:'''Chiwen:''' I'll have the Rafter Kites taken care of, you may focus on your task at hand.

;Switching place with Qiuhong after he visited Yuan's Flavor
:'''Qiuhong:''' Here you go! The Stir-Fried Trio is for you, plus some Sovereign Spice courtesy of the owner!
:'''Chiwen:''' Thanks, Commander! Aren't you gonna have some? Flavor Under Heaven from Yuan's Flavors is the best!
:'''Qiuhong:''' That's more spice than I can handle. A bowl of Jade Broth Noodles is more than enough for me!

==Dialogue==
:{{DIcon}} I want to deliver Rafter Kites
::'''Chiwen:''' I heard you found a Rafter Kite with quite a bit of history behind it?
;Rafter Kite submitted
::'''Chiwen:''' The Xuanlings of old do still live on in the design of the Rafter Kites...
;Level up
::'''Chiwen:''' This one is in remarkably good shape... On Commander Qiuhong's behalf, thank you!
;No Rafter Kite submitted
::'''Chiwen:''' If you find any more unclaimed Rafter Kites, I'll take every last one.
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Chiwen:''' Commander Qiuhong used to serve in Mengzhou's Ministry of War, but after a misjudgment in one campaign, they demoted him. Sent him to Xuanfang Hold.
::'''Chiwen:''' Many people said it would break him... Some even make remarks about how he's never at the Ministry of War.
::'''Chiwen:''' I'm only a soldier, but I know a real commander doesn't sit in a camp all day playing war on paper.
::'''Chiwen:''' I came to cover this post because I like studying Rafter Kites. But Commander Qiuhong is after something else. He's after the military intelligence they carry...
::'''Chiwen:''' With him around, Xuanfang will only grow more peaceful.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue End}}
